definition.name: quantum_state_tomography
definition.definition: Quantum state tomography is the task of estimating an unknown quantum state rho from n copies (independent preparations) of rho. The goal is to output an estimate rho_hat such that F(rho, rho_hat) >= 1 - epsilon with probability >= 1 - delta, using as few copies n as possible. For a rank-r state in C^{d x d}, the optimal sample complexity is Theta(rd/epsilon) for constant delta. Pure state tomography (r=1) requires Theta(d/epsilon) copies. The paper shows that mixed state tomography literally reduces to pure state tomography via the purification channel.
